story: Ahjumawi Lava Springs State Park preserves a wilderness of freshwater springs and recent lava flows in northeastern Shasta County, California. It is only accessible to the public by boat and features blue bays and tree-studded islets.
matters: The park sits on one of the nation's largest systems of underwater springs, producing billions of gallons of fresh water daily into aboveground waterways.
name: Ahjumawi Lava Springs State Park
